title: Kevin!!!!! is fun for the whole family ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
transcript: Recent cutbacks is one of the main stays here at fringe with hold on to your butts, the shot for shot Jurassic Park remake and Fly You Fools, the shot for shot Lord of the rings remake. They are back this year with a new show, Kevin 5 exclamation points, which is a shot for shot recreation of Home Alone using puppetry, live action, combining a green screen technology and live Foley all in one. This was an absolute blast. And as somebody who has seen a Home Alone once or twice in my life but is not hugely familiar with it, this felt incredibly accessible. I knew what was happening at all times. The way that they were able to combine all of these mediums in 2 one was really creative and entertaining. And this truly is fun for the whole family. There were a lot of little kids there that were absolutely enthralled with this recreation. I think this is a great way to get the imagination gears going and be entertained for an hour. There were definitely a few slower sections of the film that because I wasn't super familiar with the film, I did find myself going, why don't we just get to the fun bits at the end? But overall, I absolutely enjoyed myself. And if you've never seen any of recent cutbacks work, I definitely recommend them. I now want to see their other two shows because this was absolutely hilarious.
